
name: Build Acode APK

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: acode-build-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build Android APK
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          submodules: recursive

      - name: Apply patches
        run: |
          git apply --check acode-storage-fix.patch acode-paste-quicktool.patch
          git apply acode-storage-fix.patch acode-paste-quicktool.patch

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '21'

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 'lts/*'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          npm install
          npm install -g cordova
          npm run setup

      - name: Prepare storage manager
        run: node utils/storage_manager.mjs y

      - name: Build APK
        run: npm run build paid dev apk

      - name: Inspect APK
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          APK="platforms/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk"

          if [ ! -s "$APK" ]; then
            echo "::error::APK missing or empty"
            exit 1
          fi

          BUILD_TOOLS=$(find "$ANDROID_HOME/build-tools" \
            -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d \
            | sort -V | tail -n 1)

          echo "=== APK INFO ==="
          file "$APK"

          echo "=== ZIP INTEGRITY ==="
          unzip -t "$APK"

          echo "=== APK SIGNATURE ==="
          "$BUILD_TOOLS/apksigner" verify --verbose --print-certs "$APK"

          echo "=== APK PACKAGE ==="
          "$BUILD_TOOLS/aapt" dump badging "$APK"

          echo "=== APK CONTENTS ==="
          unzip -l "$APK" | head -60

          echo "=== APK SHA256 ==="
          sha256sum "$APK"

      - name: Upload APK
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: acode-debug-apk
          path: platforms/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
